findings.title: Concurrent group test asserts before the reader thread finishes
findings.body: createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti starts a background thread that lists groups and records exceptions, then the main thread deletes the groups, sets deletedAll, and immediately asserts that caughtExceptions is empty. The reader is never started-before-delete, never joined, and has no timeout. The assertion can therefore run before the reader has executed a single request, or while a request that began before deletedAll was set is still in flight and has not yet recorded its exception. A regression of the concurrent NPE can pass this test, and the thread can keep using managedRealm.admin() after the test method returns and realm cleanup starts, which is also racy against the admin client.
